script.title: 'You have more stuff than we estimated': 1 moving day flag
script.hook: 1 loaded truck, 1 new price: double the estimate, because you have more stuff.

segments.heading: Hook
segments.narration: Everything's on the truck. Then the foreman says: you have way more stuff than we estimated. The price just doubled.
segments.visual_prompt: Clean flat vector illustration, deep navy and cream with teal and amber warning accents, simple shapes. a foreman with a clipboard by a full truck No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: The flag
segments.narration: FMCSA lists exactly this as a red flag: the mover claims you have more belongings than estimated.
segments.visual_prompt: Clean flat vector illustration, deep navy and cream with teal and amber warning accents, simple shapes. a red flag on a truck No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: Your rights
segments.narration: For a move across state lines, the mover must give you a booklet called Your Rights and Responsibilities When You Move. Read it before moving day.
segments.visual_prompt: Clean flat vector illustration, deep navy and cream with teal and amber warning accents, simple shapes. a booklet on a box No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: Do this
segments.narration: Get a written estimate that lists everything first. Problems with an interstate mover? File a complaint with FMCSA.
segments.on_screen_text: Written estimate first. Complain to FMCSA.
segments.visual_prompt: Clean flat vector illustration, deep navy and cream with teal and amber warning accents, simple shapes. the small round teal shield mascot with big curious eyes filing a form No text, no logos, no real people.
